svg.aria-label: Keepwell. Live demo · pre-pilot. Maintenance for estates, factories, campuses and hotels. The technician’s app keeps working in a plant room with no signal, and two people can never be promised the same spare part. Built with Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and Angular. The screenshot shows the manager’s overview with the jobs that need a decision, on sample data.
